data.title: Comparing Coin Groups Fun!
data.description: Practice comparing coin groups with coins.

challenges.instruction: Look at the two handfuls of coins for a gummy bear. Which group is worth more?
challenges.hint: Count the pennies (1¢) and nickels (5¢) carefully!

challenges.instruction: Time for lollipops! Compare these dimes (10¢) and pennies (1¢) to see which is worth more.
challenges.hint: Dimes are worth much more than pennies. Check the dimes first!

challenges.instruction: Chocolate bar time! Which pocket of coins has a greater total value?
challenges.hint: Count your nickels by fives and add your pennies last.

challenges.instruction: Sour candy belts! Look at these mixed coins. Which group buys the bigger belt?
challenges.hint: Find the total value of Group A by counting the dime first, then nickels and pennies.

challenges.instruction: The giant jawbreaker! Use your quarter (25¢) knowledge to compare these big groups.
challenges.hint: A quarter is worth 25¢, which is more than any dime, nickel, or penny!

challenges.instruction: The ultimate candy basket! Compare these large handfuls of mixed coins to find the maximum value.
challenges.hint: Add up all the quarters and dimes first, then add the smaller coins.
